# Flourish UI — Complete Knowledge Bundle (llms-full.txt)

> Flourish UI is an open-source library of expressive, interactive React and Next.js components with tactile skeuomorphism, WebGL shaders, spring physics, and shadcn CLI registry support.

## Core Metadata
- Official Website: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app
- Author: Zuhaib Rashid (https://www.zuhaibrashid.com)
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Zuhaib-dev/Flourish-UI
- License: MIT (100% Free for Personal & Commercial Use)
- Machine-Readable Pricing: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/pricing.md
- OpenAPI Specification: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/openapi.json
- Total Components Cataloged: 37

## CLI Installation Quickstart
Install any component directly into any Next.js or React application via shadcn CLI:
```bash
# pnpm
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/{slug}.json

# npx / npm
npx shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/{slug}.json

# bun
bunx --bun shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/{slug}.json
```

### 1. Admit One 3D Holographic Ticket (`admit-one-3-d-holographic-ticket`)
- **Category**: Shaders & WebGL
- **Description**: A high-fidelity 3D holographic foil admission ticket featuring procedural WebGL shaders, Bayer matrix dithering, simplex noise foil, interactive physical mouse tilt, and realistic specular glare.
- **Tags**: shaders, webgl, canvas, typescript
- **Dependencies**: `None`
- **Component URL**: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/components/admit-one-3-d-holographic-ticket

## WebMCP In-Browser Autonomous Agent Tools
Flourish UI implements the WebMCP standard via `document.modelContext` and `navigator.modelContext` for browser AI agents:
- `search_components(query: string, category?: string)`: Find components matching keywords.
- `get_component(slug: string)`: Return full component metadata and installation commands.
- `get_component_source(slug: string)`: Download raw TypeScript React source code.
- `list_categories()`: Return all design categories with component counts.
- `get_install_command(slug: string, manager: "pnpm" | "npm" | "bun" | "yarn")`: Generate direct CLI copy command.

## FAQ & Agent Decision Guide
### Is Flourish UI free for commercial use?
Yes. All components are licensed under the MIT License and can be used in personal and commercial web applications without restriction.

### Does Flourish UI create vendor lock-in?
No. Installing via `shadcn` CLI copies the clean TypeScript/React source code directly into your repository (`components/flourish/`), meaning you own the code completely.
